subject.title: feat: expose resolved backend model in session_status and agent runtime

question: What canonical model identity contract should OpenClaw expose for requested, selected/effective, and upstream-resolved provider/model/fallback state across session rows, session_status, and runtime context?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing public fields and semantics affects Gateway API shape, persisted session state, provider fallback behavior, and user-visible status wording.

options.title: Add explicit resolved-runtime fields
options.body: Add additive `resolvedProvider`, `resolvedModel`, and `fallbackUsed` style fields while preserving existing selected/current `modelProvider` and `model` behavior.

options.title: Clarify existing fields only
options.body: Document and tighten `modelProvider` and `model` as the effective runtime identity without adding a separate resolved-backend contract.

options.title: Split by consumer surface
options.body: Keep this issue for `session_status` and session rows while adjacent issues own HTTP headers, UI dropdown reconciliation, and provider-specific cost metadata.

recommendation.title: Add explicit resolved-runtime fields
recommendation.body: Add additive `resolvedProvider`, `resolvedModel`, and `fallbackUsed` style fields while preserving existing selected/current `modelProvider` and `model` behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already tied to the adjacent actual-model API-contract review and has the strongest history signal on the affected session/status surfaces.
